scope: Exact spreadsheet, expense-tracker and Office archives: canonical dates, conversion, untouched-sheet formula/numeric-value, free refusals and signed offline-Pro XLSX export
limitations: Not an exploit test or blanket security certification
No guarantee for arbitrary formatting, macros, external links or all Office children
Network guard covers ordinary Node fetch/http/https/net/tls/dgram APIs and inherited Node child processes; not an OS network sandbox
Untouched-sheet formula and numeric value are checked; existing cellNF:false drops number formats in both old and new readers; edited and converted sheets replace formulas and formatting with values
